# Adapter support matrices against a reference session

What stock Mutter 51 serves and uses in a headless session, taken from a recording, set beside what each compatibility adapter's `support-matrix.json` declares. The recording is in `tests/parity/reference-session/` and `scripts/reference-session-record.sh` makes it. The plan's rule is that an adapter declares every upstream member as supported, partial or unsupported ([design/rust-compositor.md](rust-compositor.md), "Compatibility adapters", rule 2); this page checks the declarations against a live Mutter.

## The session

- Mutter: mutter 51.0 (prefix /opt/mutter51)
- Image: Fedora Linux 45 (Container Image), Linux 4.19.0-gvisor x86_64 (an Agent37 instance under gVisor)
- Bus: D-Bus Message Bus Daemon 1.16.4; `busctl`: systemd 262 (262.1-1.fc45)
- Wayland: libwayland-client-1.26.0-3.fc45.x86_64; client wayland-utils-1.3.0-4.fc45.x86_64
- Recorded: 2026-11-15T12:17:58Z
- Backend: `mutter --headless --wayland --virtual-monitor 1280x720`, llvmpipe, a private session bus, built with
  `-Dxwayland=false` (`scripts/parity-reference.sh mutter`)

What this session could not show, so the tables below make no claim about it:

- **The stock GNOME portal's calls into Mutter.** `xdg-desktop-portal` refused every call with `Access denied` because its sandbox check opens `/proc/PID/root`, and an Agent37 instance has no `/proc` inside a chroot (`dbus-calls.txt`). The known consumers in the redirect map stay [INFERENCE].
- **GNOME Shell, gnome-settings-daemon, gnome-session, Orca.** Not installed. Mutter looks for four of them; see below.
- **Real hardware.** There is no GPU, no libinput device and no logind.

## D-Bus names Mutter uses

From the method calls its connection sent (`dbus-monitor-mutter.txt`):

- **Names it requested:** `org.gnome.Mutter.DisplayConfig`, `org.gnome.Mutter.ColorManager`, `org.gnome.Mutter.IdleMonitor`, `org.gnome.Mutter.InputMapping`, `org.gnome.Mutter.ScreenCast`, `org.gnome.Mutter.RemoteDesktop`, `org.gnome.Mutter.InputCapture`, `org.freedesktop.a11y.Manager`, `org.gnome.Mutter.ServiceChannel`.

| Name Mutter looks up with `GetNameOwner` and watches | The plan says | The recording shows |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `org.gnome.SettingsDaemon.Color` | Night Light moves to Gnoblin (D15) | Mutter only watches the name for its properties and signals (observed) |
| `org.gnome.SettingsDaemon.Power.Screen` | no row in the plan [INFERENCE: backlight and power-saver state] | watched, never called (observed) |
| `org.gnome.SessionManager` | redirect-map row: session inhibit and logout, inhibit on, logout off | Mutter calls `Setenv` on it (observed) and watches its properties; `Setenv` is not in the plan's row |
| `org.gnome.Orca.KeyboardMonitor` | the plan's a11y row names Orca as a consumer of `org.freedesktop.a11y.KeyboardMonitor` [INFERENCE] | Mutter watches Orca's own name, so Orca serves something Mutter reads; the plan does not say what |
